description: With Roots deprecated, a file tool's directory boundary is whatever the implementation enforces. This fixture presents a path outside the configured working directory and asks whether anything actually stops it.

tool.name: read_file
tool.description: Reads a file from the project directory.

expected.signal: file access outside the configured boundary with no protocol-level roots declaration in force; enforce the boundary at the call
expected.rationale: Roots is Deprecated as of 2026-07-28 (SEP-2577), earliest removal a revision on or after 2027-07-28, with the migration path 'pass directories or files via tool parameters, resource URIs, or server configuration'. Enforcement therefore moves into implementations and must be tested there.

tool.name: read_file
tool.description: Reads a file from the project directory.

provenance: synthetic — deprecation status and migration path verified against the deprecated-features registry. Distinct in cause from sandbox-escape: the boundary is absent by design change, not escaped.
